# Lean 4 machine check for LEMMA.md (Tier 1)

Machine-checks the certificate-level core of `../LEMMA.md` / paper1 Section 5:
the polynomial identity chain by which the generic-chart ideal of
`open_8_28_c2` contains 1 (cofactor 1 against generator 44, the constant −1).

## Contents

- `Jc/Culprit.lean` — auto-generated by `../cases/export_lean.py` from the
  recorded Cascade3 + two_chart event log (same machinery as
  `../cases/eq3_chain.py`). Two theorems:
  - **(A) `eq3_at_b3_zero`**: the untouched vertex equation
    `eq #3 = a1*b3 − 1` evaluates at `b3 = 0` to `−1` (the unique constant
    of the census; the "generator 44 = −1" fact on the generic chart).
    A plain `CommRing` identity.
  - **(B) `culprit_key36_reduction`**: the original key-(3,6) bracket
    coefficient `3·a2·b10 − a3·b9 + 2·a5·b6 − 2·a6·b5 + a8·b2 − 3·a9·b1`,
    after the 10 recorded collapse events (zero b1, zero b2, elim
    b10, b9, b8, b7, b6, b5, b4, zero a3 — each elimination hypothesis
    `h·` is the exact substitution polynomial `g` logged by the cascade),
    equals `(−1/5)·a2²·a6·ia1²·b3`. Stated in the localized ring of the
    generic chart: the adjoined unit relations `ia1*a1 = 1`, `ib43*b43 = 1`
    are hypotheses `hu1`/`hu2`. The closing `ring` does not consume them —
    `a1`, `b43` never occur in the chain, so the identity already holds in
    the free commutative ring (strictly stronger; it specializes to the
    localization). Over a field of characteristic 0 so the literal rational
    coefficients elaborate; denominators are the pivot-constant primes
    {2,3,5} only (LEMMA.md denominator hygiene). Proved by `subst` + `ring`.
    Axiom check (`#print axioms`): (A) `propext` only; (B) `propext`,
    `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound` — no `sorry`.

## Scope — what is and is not formalized

Formalized: the explicit polynomial identity chain of the 10-event collapse —
that the recorded substitutions really do reduce the key-(3,6) coefficient to
`(−1/5)·a2²·a6·ia1²·b3` (B), and that the vertex equation then evaluates to
the constant `−1` once `b3 = 0` (A). NOT formalized: that the listed
polynomials are in fact the bracket coefficients of `[P,Q] − x²` for
`open_8_28_c2`; that the elimination/chart steps are sound (variety- or
saturation-preserving), i.e. that the `g`'s are consequences of the ideal;
the counting/census theorem (51 zero / 40 polynomial / 1 constant); the
candidate general vertex–gap lemma; and any msolve/Gröbner results. Those
remain certified only by the Python replay (`cases/eq3_chain.py`) and the
audits in the repository.

## Toolchain versions

- elan 4.2.3, Lean `leanprover/lean4:v4.32.2` (arm64-apple-darwin, release)
- mathlib4 pinned to tag `v4.32.2` (rev `905b95818eb3`, via `lakefile.toml`),
  binaries from `lake exe cache get` (8639 cached files; no mathlib compile)
- project compile: `lake build` ≈ 4 s wall (Jc.Culprit ≈ 1.2 s)

## Build

```
cd lean && lake exe cache get && lake build
```
